what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Guinea-Bissau.
The only figure for people displaced by conflict is from UNHCR, which counted 195550 in 1998.
IDMC's data for Guinea-Bissau records only displacement by disasters.

why.text: The sources here don't record the causes of the displacement in 1998: there are no dated events or armed conflicts for Guinea-Bissau in them.
Storms are the disasters recorded for Guinea-Bissau in IDMC's data.

when.text: UNHCR's figure covers 1998 only, the main year of displacement in the data.
IDMC recorded 3017 new displacements from disasters in 2025.

how.text: IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people: someone forced to move twice in a year is counted twice.
Refugees from Guinea-Bissau are few and live mainly in France.
The sources don't say where inside Guinea-Bissau people moved to.
